name: A failed archive hook blocks removal; --force does not waive it

attrs.quote: With --run-hooks, a failed archive hook blocks the removal: nothing is stopped, deleted or deregistered, and the command exits non-zero with error code worktree_archive_hook_failed. --force does not waive this.
attrs.note: --allow-failed-archive-hook deletes anyway after the hook has failed; it requires --run-hooks.
